COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSS No. 1284 of 2022
Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.
Mr. K.K. Harbola, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. Rakesh Kunwar, Additional C.S.C.
for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Bhupendra Singh Bisht, Advocate
for respondent no. 2.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Petitioner served as Junior Assistant in
Uttarakhand Peyjal Sansadhan Vikas Evam
Nirm an Nigam and retired from service on
30.11.2021.
Since retiral dues have not been paid
to him so far, therefore, he has filed this
writ petition seeking a direction to the
respondents to release his outstanding
dues.
Learned counsel for respondent no. 2,
on instructions, subm its that all the dues, as
claim ed by the petitioner in the relief
clause, have been duly sanctioned,
however, on account of financial crunch
faced by Uttarakhand Peyjal Sansadhan
Vikas Evam Nirm an Nigam, outstanding
dues could not be paid to petitioner. He,
however, assures the Court that all the

outstanding dues would be released to
petitioner as soon as possible.
I n such view of the m atter, the writ
petition is disposed of with the following
directions:
The am ount of gratuity shall be paid to
the petitioner within two m onths from the
date of production of certified copy of the
order. The am ount of gratuity shall also
carry interest as per the provisions of
Paym ent of Gratuity Act, 1972. The am ount
of leave encashm ent shall be paid to the
petitioner within four m onths from the date
of production of certified copy of the order.
All other dues shall be paid to the petitioner
positively within a period of five m onths
from the date of production of certified copy
of the order. I n case of any further delay
beyond the stipulated period, petitioner
shall also be entitled to sim ple interest @
5% per annum on such delayed paym ent.
Representation subm itted by the
petitioner, regarding his pay fixation, shall
also be decided by Managing Director,
within eight weeks from today.

( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.)
 08.07.2022
Arpan
